# Aim

This script checks why some GO/Reactome enrichment dotplots are empty and regenerates plots only when enrichment results contain valid terms.
The relaxed parameter are: 
pvalueCutoff = 1
qvalueCutoff = 1

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
})
```

# Paths

```{r paths}
OUT_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/MOFA2"

INTERP_DIR <- file.path(
  OUT_DIR,
  "MOFA2_Clinical_Association",
  "Grade_Associated_Factor_Interpretation"
)

GENE_DIR <- file.path(INTERP_DIR, "Gene_Lists")
ENRICH_DIR <- file.path(INTERP_DIR, "Enrichment")
```

# Check enrichment result CSV files

```{r check-enrichment-csvs}
enrich_csvs <- list.files(
  ENRICH_DIR,
  pattern = "_enrichment\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

cat("Number of enrichment CSV files found:", length(enrich_csvs), "\n")
print(basename(enrich_csvs))

enrichment_qc <- rbindlist(lapply(enrich_csvs, function(f) {
  dt <- tryCatch(
    fread(f, data.table = TRUE),
    error = function(e) data.table()
  )

  if (nrow(dt) == 0) {
    return(data.table(
      File = basename(f),
      N_terms = 0,
      N_padj_lt_0_05 = 0,
      N_padj_lt_0_10 = 0,
      N_pvalue_lt_0_05 = 0,
      Min_pvalue = NA_real_,
      Min_padjust = NA_real_,
      Status = "EMPTY_OR_UNREADABLE"
    ))
  }

  pval_col <- if ("pvalue" %in% colnames(dt)) "pvalue" else NA_character_
  padj_col <- if ("p.adjust" %in% colnames(dt)) "p.adjust" else if ("p.adjust." %in% colnames(dt)) "p.adjust." else NA_character_

  data.table(
    File = basename(f),
    N_terms = nrow(dt),
    N_padj_lt_0_05 = if (!is.na(padj_col)) sum(dt[[padj_col]] < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_integer_,
    N_padj_lt_0_10 = if (!is.na(padj_col)) sum(dt[[padj_col]] < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_integer_,
    N_pvalue_lt_0_05 = if (!is.na(pval_col)) sum(dt[[pval_col]] < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_integer_,
    Min_pvalue = if (!is.na(pval_col)) min(dt[[pval_col]], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    Min_padjust = if (!is.na(padj_col)) min(dt[[padj_col]], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    Status = "READABLE"
  )
}), fill = TRUE)

fwrite(
  enrichment_qc,
  file.path(QC_DIR, "MOFA2_enrichment_result_file_QC.csv")
)

print(enrichment_qc)
```

# Safe plotting from existing enrichment CSVs

```{r safe-plot-existing-csvs}
plot_enrichment_csv <- function(csv_file, out_pdf, top_n = 15) {
  dt <- fread(csv_file, data.table = TRUE)

  if (nrow(dt) == 0) {
    message("[SKIP] Empty enrichment table: ", basename(csv_file))
    return(NULL)
  }

  needed_cols <- c("Description", "p.adjust")
  if (!all(needed_cols %in% colnames(dt))) {
    message("[SKIP] Required columns missing: ", basename(csv_file))
    return(NULL)
  }

  dt <- dt[!is.na(Description) & !is.na(p.adjust)]
  dt <- dt[order(p.adjust, pvalue)]

  if (nrow(dt) == 0) {
    message("[SKIP] No valid rows after filtering: ", basename(csv_file))
    return(NULL)
  }

  dt <- dt[1:min(.N, top_n)]

  dt[, neg_log10_fdr := -log10(p.adjust)]
  dt[is.infinite(neg_log10_fdr), neg_log10_fdr := max(neg_log10_fdr[is.finite(neg_log10_fdr)], na.rm = TRUE)]

  dt[, Description := factor(Description, levels = rev(Description))]

  # Try to parse GeneRatio if available
  if ("GeneRatio" %in% colnames(dt)) {
    dt[, GeneRatio_numeric := sapply(GeneRatio, function(x) {
      parts <- strsplit(as.character(x), "/")[[1]]
      if (length(parts) == 2) {
        return(as.numeric(parts[1]) / as.numeric(parts[2]))
      } else {
        return(NA_real_)
      }
    })]
  } else {
    dt[, GeneRatio_numeric := NA_real_]
  }

  p <- ggplot(
    dt,
    aes(
      x = neg_log10_fdr,
      y = Description
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(size = Count),
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    labs(
      title = gsub("_", " ", sub("_enrichment\\.csv$", "", basename(csv_file))),
      x = "-log10(FDR)",
      y = NULL,
      size = "Gene count"
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    out_pdf,
    p,
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )

  message("[SAVED] ", out_pdf)
  return(p)
}

for (f in enrich_csvs) {
  out_pdf <- file.path(
    SAFE_PLOT_DIR,
    paste0(sub("_enrichment\\.csv$", "", basename(f)), "_safe_dotplot.pdf")
  )

  try(plot_enrichment_csv(f, out_pdf), silent = FALSE)
}
```

# Re-run enrichment with relaxed cutoffs for exploratory review

This step reruns enrichment with `pvalueCutoff = 1` and `qvalueCutoff = 1`, then exports all terms. This does **not** mean all terms are significant. It is only for inspection and plotting. Use FDR later to decide significance.

```{r rerun-enrichment-relaxed}
run_relaxed_enrichment <- function(gene_file, label) {
  genes <- readLines(gene_file)
  genes <- unique(trimws(genes))
  genes <- genes[genes != "" & !is.na(genes)]

  message("\n==============================")
  message(label)
  message("Input genes: ", length(genes))
  message("==============================")

  if (length(genes) < 10) {
    message("[SKIP] Too few genes.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  results <- list()

  # GO BP
  if (requireNamespace("clusterProfiler", quietly = TRUE) &&
      requireNamespace("org.Hs.eg.db", quietly = TRUE)) {

    suppressPackageStartupMessages({
      library(clusterProfiler)
      library(org.Hs.eg.db)
    })

    ego <- tryCatch({
      enrichGO(
        gene          = genes,
        OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
        keyType       = "SYMBOL",
        ont           = "BP",
        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
        pvalueCutoff  = 1,
        qvalueCutoff  = 1,
        readable      = TRUE
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("[GO ERROR] ", e$message)
      NULL
    })

    if (!is.null(ego)) {
      ego_dt <- as.data.table(ego@result)

      out_csv <- file.path(
        ENRICH_DIR,
        paste0(label, "_GO_BP_enrichment_relaxed_all_terms.csv")
      )

      fwrite(ego_dt, out_csv)
      message("[SAVED] ", out_csv, " | N terms = ", nrow(ego_dt))

      results$GO_BP <- ego_dt
    }
  } else {
    message("[SKIP] clusterProfiler/org.Hs.eg.db not installed.")
  }

  # Reactome
  if (requireNamespace("ReactomePA", quietly = TRUE) &&
      requireNamespace("clusterProfiler", quietly = TRUE) &&
      requireNamespace("org.Hs.eg.db", quietly = TRUE)) {

    suppressPackageStartupMessages({
      library(ReactomePA)
      library(clusterProfiler)
      library(org.Hs.eg.db)
    })

    entrez <- tryCatch({
      bitr(
        genes,
        fromType = "SYMBOL",
        toType = "ENTREZID",
        OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("[ID CONVERSION ERROR] ", e$message)
      NULL
    })

    if (!is.null(entrez) && nrow(entrez) >= 10) {
      er <- tryCatch({
        enrichPathway(
          gene = unique(entrez$ENTREZID),
          organism = "human",
          pvalueCutoff = 1,
          pAdjustMethod = "BH",
          readable = TRUE
        )
      }, error = function(e) {
        message("[REACTOME ERROR] ", e$message)
        NULL
      })

      if (!is.null(er)) {
        er_dt <- as.data.table(er@result)

        out_csv <- file.path(
          ENRICH_DIR,
          paste0(label, "_Reactome_enrichment_relaxed_all_terms.csv")
        )

        fwrite(er_dt, out_csv)
        message("[SAVED] ", out_csv, " | N terms = ", nrow(er_dt))

        results$Reactome <- er_dt
      }
    } else {
      message("[SKIP] Too few mapped ENTREZ IDs for Reactome.")
    }
  } else {
    message("[SKIP] ReactomePA/clusterProfiler/org.Hs.eg.db not installed.")
  }

  results
}

gene_files <- list.files(
  GENE_DIR,
  pattern = "_RNA_top200_protein_coding_for_enrichment\\.txt$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

cat("RNA top200 protein-coding gene files found:\n")
print(basename(gene_files))

relaxed_results <- list()

for (gf in gene_files) {
  label <- sub("_for_enrichment\\.txt$", "", basename(gf))
  relaxed_results[[label]] <- run_relaxed_enrichment(gf, label)
}
```

# Final QC summary after relaxed enrichment

```{r final-qc}
all_enrich_csvs <- list.files(
  ENRICH_DIR,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

final_qc <- rbindlist(lapply(all_enrich_csvs, function(f) {
  dt <- tryCatch(fread(f, data.table = TRUE), error = function(e) data.table())

  if (nrow(dt) == 0) {
    return(data.table(
      File = basename(f),
      N_terms = 0,
      N_FDR_lt_0_05 = 0,
      N_FDR_lt_0_10 = 0,
      Min_FDR = NA_real_,
      Min_P = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  data.table(
    File = basename(f),
    N_terms = nrow(dt),
    N_FDR_lt_0_05 = if ("p.adjust" %in% colnames(dt)) sum(dt$p.adjust < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_integer_,
    N_FDR_lt_0_10 = if ("p.adjust" %in% colnames(dt)) sum(dt$p.adjust < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_integer_,
    Min_FDR = if ("p.adjust" %in% colnames(dt)) min(dt$p.adjust, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    Min_P = if ("pvalue" %in% colnames(dt)) min(dt$pvalue, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
  )
}), fill = TRUE)

fwrite(
  final_qc,
  file.path(QC_DIR, "MOFA2_enrichment_final_QC_summary.csv")
)

print(final_qc[order(Min_FDR)])
```
